data.title: 神罚 · 玫瑰水汽的静谧私汤
data.description: 水汽氤氲的热石浴池中漂浮着绯红的玫瑰花瓣。神罚浸在清澈温热的泉水中，湿漉微卷的银白发丝贴在发烫微红的雪白肩头。她双手合拢捧起一掬温水，目光羞怯而含情脉脉地抬起视线，水珠顺着精致的锁骨滑落，呈现出毫无防备的动人风致。
data.location: luxury private bathroom with steam and warm candlelight
data.action: 浸在温热泉水中，双手合拢捧起一掬温水，羞怯又依恋地仰望
data.lighting: warm flickering candlelight reflecting on steamy water ripples
data.promptProse: Viewed slightly from above in a warm stone bath strewn with floating crimson rose petals, Modernia holds a small scoop of water in her cupped hands and looks up shyly. Soft candlelight flickers across the steam and water droplets on her skin.
data.animaCaption: Soaking nude in a candlelit stone bath scattered with red rose petals, she cups warm water in both palms and gazes shyly upward through the steam with deeply flushed cheeks.
data.nsfwProse: Completely unclothed in the clear bathwater up to her chest, her bare shoulders, damp collarbones, and gentle cleavage gleam warmly among the drifting petals.
